entries.24f6b306488d0099: It manufactures and sells connectors used in electronic and electrical equipment such as industrial equipment, automotive devices and imaging equipment, racks that house control boards and peripheral devices, and harnesses that connect connectors and cables.
entries.381314e223036eca: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥210 million. Rising raw material prices and higher costs weighed on results, and net income fell 47.6% from the previous year.
entries.39d5f962b8510692: As a connector specialist, it is a business model that manufactures and sells connectors that link printed circuit boards and equipment, racks that house control boards and other components, and cable harnesses with connectors.
entries.3d5dfac3cbd8eb5e: As a connector specialist, it states that it will constantly pursue cutting-edge connection technology (Connection Technology), respond to industrial equipment that is becoming denser and faster, develop products that anticipate market needs, and continue supplying them to the market.
entries.4173aaccf43799c3: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,857 million, up 8.3% from the previous year. Connectors accounted for ¥11,293 million, racks for ¥1,376 million and other products for ¥186 million.
entries.488a1d5a98000c95: Since its founding, its basic approach has been to supply high-quality small connectors to the electronics market. It says it is strengthening its global structure for development, supply and sales capabilities to expand overseas sales, and advancing new product development and the development of priority markets. It also has a long-term management plan, “KEL VISION 2030,” targeting 2030.
entries.641f5e5f19be1aa2: Founded in 1962 in Shibuya, Tokyo, it is a company headquartered in Tama, Tokyo. As of March 31, 2026, it had 334 employees and, with 7 subsidiaries, forms a group.
entries.690de833ac0609eb: Connectors for electrical connection and disconnection between mounted printed circuit boards, within equipment, and between equipment, in electronic and electrical equipment such as industrial equipment and imaging equipment. They include floating connectors for automotive equipment and connectors for ultra-fine coaxial cables for medical equipment. Net sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥11,293 million.
